- CLAUDE.md:1973 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The merged-report terminal rename form is missing the `#<issue> · ` prefix annotation that the closed-report form carries.
  WHY: This documents inconsistent session naming for terminal states and omits the issue-number prefix expected for numbered session titles.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:131 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The Session titles rule names steps 3a, 6, 8, 10, 11, and 12 as PR-opening steps that rename themselves, but steps 8, 10, 11, and 12 lack rename instructions.
  WHY: A stage session running one of those steps opens a PR without putting its PR number in the session title, contradicting the rule and the PR description evidence table.
- tests/test_session_titles.py:70-75 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The test does not assert that steps 8, 10, 11, and 12 carry rename instructions despite asserting the rule that names those steps.
  WHY: The test passes against the incomplete implementation and cannot detect the gap between the rule and the step instructions.
- tests/test_session_titles.py:test_checker_titles_old_new_and_hand_prefixed_all_match (parametrised block) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The positive parametrised cases do not test a hand-renamed title with arbitrary prefix text and the slug-matching phrase mid-string.
  WHY: The documented promise that the matcher accepts titles renamed by hand is not pinned by a test.

- TASK_GAP

  Expected change site: `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` and its `.claude/commands/` twin, steps 8 (conformance fix), 10 (validation fix), 11 (completion PR), and 12 (verify-activation fix).
  Evidence of absence: The `set_session_title` rename instruction is explicitly implemented only in step 3a and step 6; steps 8, 10, 11, and 12 lack this instruction, leaving these automation stages unnumbered.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Requirement: "A stage renames itself on PR open" tested by `test_stage_renames_itself_when_it_opens_a_pr`; the test must cover every step named by the Session titles rule.
  Expected change site: `tests/test_session_titles.py::test_stage_renames_itself_when_it_opens_a_pr`
  Evidence of absence: The test implementation asserts rename instructions only for steps 3a and 6, failing to verify that the renaming requirement is met for steps 8, 10, 11, and 12.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Session titles rule at line 131, vs rename text in steps 3a (line 25) and 6 (line 38) only | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rule documents 6 steps as PR-renaming steps, but the diff only added the explicit `rename this session with that PR per [Session titles](#session-titles)` text in steps 3a and 6. Steps 8 (conformance fix PR, line 53), 10 (validation fix PR, line 67), 11 (completion PR, line 73), and 12 (verify-activation fix PR, line 77) open PRs but contain no rename instruction.
  WHY: An operator (or a future stage session) following the Session titles rule will attempt to rename itself in steps 8, 10, 11, and 12, but the rule will not match the step body (no rename instruction to execute), and the resulting session title will lack the `#<issue> · PR #<pr> — ` prefix the rule promises.
- tests/test_session_titles.py: test_stage_renames_itself_when_it_opens_a_pr, lines 70-75 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test only asserts the rule documentation text and rename instructions in steps 3a and 6; it does not assert that steps 8, 10, 11, and 12 carry rename instructions.
  WHY: The test cannot detect the gap between the rule and the implementation; a regression that drops the rename instruction from step 6 still leaves the test passing on the 3a-only baseline.
- tests/test_session_titles.py: test_checker_titles_old_new_and_hand_prefixed_all_match parametrised block | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The positive parametrised cases all have the slug-matching phrase at the end of the string, and all prefixes are the documented numbers template; no test exercises a hand-renamed title with arbitrary prefix text.
  WHY: The matcher function `_checker_title_matches` uses Python `in` on the literal phrase, so it would work in practice, but the test does not pin the documented promise of accepting hand-renamed titles with arbitrary prefix text.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "A stage renames itself on PR open" with the Session titles rule documenting renames for "steps 3a, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12" (workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md line 131).
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md and .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md, steps 8 (conformance fix PR), 10 (validation fix PR), 11 (completion PR), and 12 (verify-activation fix PR); the parallel test assertion in tests/test_session_titles.py::test_stage_renames_itself_when_it_opens_a_pr.
  Evidence of absence: `grep "rename this session" workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` returns 2 matches, at line 25 (step 3a) and line 38 (step 6). Steps 8 (line 53), 10 (line 67), 11 (line 73), 12 (line 77) contain no `rename this session` text. The PR description's Done evidence table (row 2) explicitly cites "steps 3a and 6" — the implementation matches Done but the Session titles rule inside the file was over-scoped.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Matchers accept both forms" with a test for old, new, hand-prefixed, and near-miss title forms. The Session titles rule explicitly promises the matcher also accepts titles that were renamed by hand, which can have arbitrary prefix text.
  Expected change site: tests/test_session_titles.py, the test_checker_titles_old_new_and_hand_prefixed_all_match parametrised block (or a new parametrised case).
  Evidence of absence: The five positive parametrised cases (lines 108-112) all have the `implement-plan <slug> — checker` or `implement-plan <slug> — waiting:` phrase at the end of the string, and all prefixes are the documented numbers template (empty, `PR #<pr> — `, or `#<issue> · PR #<pr> — `). No test exercises a hand-renamed title with arbitrary non-numbers prefix text (e.g. `issue shubhodeep1/coding-workflows#4886 — implement-plan issue-4886-numbered-session-titles — checker`, or any non-implement-plan command rename) where the slug-matching phrase is mid-string.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
